name: @amykit/plugin-file-worktree
description: One isolated checkout per piece of work, created or reused, pruned by retention.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: Use it when work changes code and each item should get a checkout of its own. It mounts the worktree port, which creates or reuses an isolated worktree per piece of work and prunes old ones after a retention period, and the workspace port, which says where each repository's checkout lives. With it mounted, command-gate, plan-check and the agents run in the item's own tree, and its operations list, remove and prune those trees.
